Fired Rockstar Employees Ask Players Not to Boycott GTA 6

Solomon Thompson Send an email 20 hours agoLast Updated: August 18, 2026
0 616
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:27
Instaread

Do not boycott GTA 6: this is what the employees fired by Rockstar Games are asking players to do, as they know that such a move would be unfair to the many former colleagues who worked hard to make the game.

“Don’t boycott GTA 6. Fight for justice for the people who made it,” reads a post published by the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain (IWGB), the union these workers belong to and which is now fighting a legal battle with the studio that fired them.

GTA 6 Developers Fired by Rockstar Tell Fans How to Support Their Legal Fight

“We spent years pouring our hard work, skill, and creativity making GTA, and we want people to experience the universe we helped build.”

“But that doesn’t mean we want you to let Rockstar off the hook,” the former employees added, as they wait for further developments in the process being handled by the IWGB.

As the date of the GTA 6 presentation on Netflix gets closer, the former Rockstar Games employees have also shared some details on how people can support their fight, including pre-ordering a T-shirt that will help cover their legal costs.

The final hearing will take place in September, and we will see how the case ends. More than thirty people were fired after being accused of “gross misconduct,” but they deny the accusations and say they were fired because they wanted to unionize.
